audio.strategy: Live additive synthesis (sine partials + amplitude envelope) for one basic piano-like voice. No recorded sample files are bundled in Phase 1.

generatedSources.name: basic-piano-additive
generatedSources.description: Four sine partials per note with velocity-scaled envelope attack/decay and exponential release. Generated at note-on via Web Audio OscillatorNode; not a recording.

notes: Phase 1 requires one dependable piano-like voice only; multi-model recorded libraries are Phase 2.
Panel controls are decorative presentation state and do not alter the audio graph.
Sustain responds to Space key, MIDI CC64, and engine API only — not decorative panel toggles.
